commonPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Art deliverable: one landscape 3:2 master WARDROBE MODEL SHEET for the Huang Xiaoxi game. Two images attached. Image 1 is a SINGLE selected outfit (the design and cut are already approved): faithfully reproduce its hairstyle, closures, materials, hem, embroidery placement, shoes, colors, weight and styling. Image 2 is exclusively the canonical character identity and 3D finish: copy her actual face, large warm brown eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin, petite age-appropriate compact proportions and friendly expression, NOT the clothes/headpiece of image 2. FRONT view, tall enough to show neck and waist, arms relaxed slightly away from body with both hands visible; absolutely no new costume design. Use the exact same front facing model, stance, framing and warm ivory background as a premium game-wardrobe catalog series.
Layout is mandatory: one fully dressed, full-length character centered in the LEFT 40 percent of the canvas, from hairstyle/accessories to both soles with about 5 percent safety margin. In the RIGHT 60 percent: exactly FOUR fully isolated wardrobe catalog items in a clean 2x2 array, with large margins and absolute separation. Upper left tile: sculpted hairstyle plus selected hair ornament as a single standalone hairpiece, NO face or neck. Upper right tile: ONLY the COMPLETE upper garment including undershirt if applicable and attached neck jewelry; on an invisible form with EMPTY NECK and empty sleeves; no body, head, skin, hands, bottoms or waist belt unless an integral part of top. Lower left tile: ONLY the entire bottom garment with visible waistband, fold detail and hem, no legs, torso or shoes. Lower right tile: a MATCHING PAIR of complete shoes together, no ankles or feet. Precisely match the four items on the figure, including pattern placement. Shoes and hair must be complete and recognizable, pants clearly separated legs, no parts touching. Each tile has its own neutral background the SAME color as the left side. All items upright at useful size, with slight natural studio contact shadow, generous negative space. No rules or border lines, no inset duplicates, swatches, numbers, typography, labels, symbols, callouts, UI controls, mannequins, logos, extra look, or disembodied hands/heads. Fine tactile fabric, realistic silver highlights, refined stylized 3D collectible doll rendering identical to the reference style. Clear enough for art director to judge how four independent wardrobe slots would fit, not a production sprite image.
